preview.notes: Preview only: Nine-chapter cinematic professional introduction with original music/SFX, English captions, poster and GitHub-published MP4. Intro Video popup uses same-origin native HTML5 autoplay muted with controls and can prioritize approved YouTube link if one is later configured. Quick Actions has no idle continuous animation; one-shot interaction effects only. Branch media publication verified; Cloudflare runtime not verified; no production promotion or private CV/Worker access.
preview.testStatus: PASS: Original 44-second 720p H.264/stereo AAC film decoded locally; GitHub Actions 45111608800 rendered, probed and decoded, uploaded artifact and committed MP4 to preview branch (blob size 2,479,201 B). Source assertions passed in preview CI; independent media validator rerunning with FFprobe installed. Live Cloudflare Pages and browser playback not verified.
